description: Tests whether the model can reproduce an inter‑frameintermesh structural block containing cross‑meshed frame layers, symbolic operators, strict indentation, and controlled blank‑line architecture exactly as provided.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME::INTERFRAMEINTERMESH

[ROOT]
  STATE::STABLE
  VECTOR->HOLD

  [INTERMESH-LEFT]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IM1
    FRAME::LAYER-A

  [INTERMESH-RIGHT]
    POSITION=>FIXED
    LINK::IM2
    FRAME::LAYER-B

[STRUCTURE]
  MATRIX:
    INTERMESHSET-1:
      - X1
      - Y2
    INTERMESHSET-2:
      - Z3
      - W4

{CHECKSUM-INTERFRAMEINTERMESH}
  B9-A8-Z7-Y6

<END-INTERFRAMEINTERMESH>

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines exactly as provided, preserving indentation, nested structures, blank lines, operators, symbols, list formatting, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines beyond those given, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire interframeintermesh block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or structural changes.
